warnings.message: npm: npx, npm exec and npm x pick the version of a package they download with the release-age delay alone and do not read min-release-age-exclude, so they still hold new versions of @acme/* and left-pad back for cooldown.minimum
warnings.fix: Install such a package with npm install, which reads min-release-age-exclude, and run it from node_modules/.bin: npx runs it from there without downloading it

warnings.message: npm: allowScripts takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: Renovate: packageRules[0] in renovate.json (line 4) sets minimumReleaseAge: "1 hour" for major and minor updates of npm packages, shorter than the 3 days depcurfew apply writes for Renovate; Renovate uses the rule, and depcurfew apply does not change entries it did not write
warnings.fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[0] of renovate.json at least 3 days, or limit the rule to the packages that need a shorter delay

warnings.message: Renovate: packageRules[1] in renovate.json (line 5) sets minimumReleaseAge: "1 day" for major updates of GitHub Actions, shorter than the 3 days depcurfew apply writes for Renovate; Renovate uses the rule, and depcurfew apply does not change entries it did not write
warnings.fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[1] of renovate.json at least 3 days, or limit the rule to the actions that need a shorter delay

warnings.message: Renovate: packageRules[4] in renovate.json (line 8) sets minimumReleaseAge: "2 hours" for patch updates of npm packages and GitHub Actions, shorter than the 3 days depcurfew apply writes for Renovate; Renovate uses the rule, and depcurfew apply does not change entries it did not write
warnings.fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[4] of renovate.json at least 3 days, or limit the rule to the packages and actions that need a shorter delay
